name: Jeju International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longest, 07/25, is 3,180 m long and 45 m wide (13/31 is 1,900 m)

hours.v: aerodrome and air traffic services open 24 hours; code F aircraft (A380 size) operate only 23:00 to 06:30 local time (1400-2130 UTC)
hours.quote: The code letter F aircraft operation time 1400 to 2130(UTC)

customs.v: customs and immigration as required by operations (HO)

handling.v: handling as required by operations (HO); general aviation aircraft are led by a follow-me vehicle or marshallers to the small-aircraft parking area
handling.quote: General aviation aircraft will be guided by the FOLLOW ME vehicle or marshallers to the parking area for small aircraft.

fuel.v: Jet A-1 by truck or hydrant; fuelling as required by operations (HO)

noise.v: all departures fly the ICAO noise abatement departure procedure one (NADP 1); delayed or reduced-flap approaches recommended
noise.quote: All departing aircraft should apply ICAO PANS-OPS(Doc.8168) Volume III Noise Abatement Departure Procedure One(NADP One).

notes: Read Korea eAIP AD 2 RKPC Jeju INTL, package 3 Apr 2025 (latest package found by search; no effective date printed on the page). AD 2.20 also bans training flights and light sport / ultralight aircraft. The AIP states no night curfew for RKPC and no slot or PPR rule; those stay missing (not confirmed as none). IATA code not printed on the page read.
